title: Will Voigt to participate in inaugural NABC Flight School presented by Nike
text:
BYU men’s basketball associate head coach Will Voigt will take part in the first-ever NABC Flight School presented by Nike on May 21, according to a May 20 announcement from the organization.
The event is designed for rising assistant coaches and athletic administrators, aiming to provide professional development through educational panel discussions, mock interviews, and networking opportunities with influential figures such as head coaches, athletic directors, conference commissioners, and search firm representatives.
NABC Executive Director Craig Robinson said, “Professional development is central to the NABC’s mission, and we’re excited to invest in the careers of this accomplished group of coaches and administrators at NABC Flight School. Our goal for NABC Flight School is to help prepare this next generation of industry leaders to make an impact both on and off the court, and we thank our partners at Nike for collaborating on launching this premium new event.”
Participants were selected after consultation with head coaches, conference offices, search firms, athletic administration associations, and other college sports stakeholders. The event will be held at the Nike Phillip H. Knight Campus outside of Portland.
During his two years in Provo as associate head coach at BYU, Voigt has helped lead the team to a record of 49-22. He was promoted last summer after assisting BYU’s advancement to the Sweet 16 in 2025 with wins over VCU and Wisconsin. This past season saw BYU finish with a record of 23-12 including a 13-game win streak—tied for fourth-longest in program history—and an NCAA Tournament appearance led by standout freshman AJ Dybantsa.
